directories.description: WHO SMART Trust Personal Health Wallet's IG Publisher AST, INGESTED here although the IG's source is not (owner, 2026-10-04: an IG's semi-static KG may stay remote, and its AST is still ingested into the folio). Read from the branch family cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/ on the IG's own repository (litlfred/smart-trust-phw), one branch per IG package id; this IG's member is cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/smart.who.int.trust-phw. Restored by fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh; absent from the checkout by design. Bean nr5p.

The artefact index for smart-trust-phw. `index.json`, `menu.json`, `releases.json` and `package.tgz` are NOT COMMITTED: fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes them at publish from the IG's AST (`builtAtPublish`, fhir-harness#124). `ig-identity.json` and the README stay committed. Bean nr5p.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Built from the IG's own AST, and GENERATED -- fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes this index at publish, a person does not edit or commit it (fhir-harness#124). A hand edit here silently changes what this repository claims upstream published, and `check:materialized-fixity` is what catches one that happened.

directories.description: How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: today `dak.coverage.smart-trust-phw.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. GENERATED at publish by the DAK layer's `gen-document-kinds.ts` (`bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds`; declared `builtAtPublish`, because the index it reads is built at publish too, fhir-harness#124) into this directory, and not committed, because the report is about this IG (folio-assistant#2598). Bean nr5p.

The reader-facing pages, generated from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json` by `smart-trust-phw:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts`). These are the artefact pages of smart-trust-phw's IG site (`igSite`, bean `mftp`): they build into smart-trust-phw's own IG site at `/smart-trust-phw/` under the IG's menu. Generated at publish, never authored or committed.

L1 normative specification snapshots materialized for smart-trust-phw: IHE ITI Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF) 1.1.0 (`ihe-iti-pcf-1-1-0`, CC BY 4.0) and IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL) 1.0.0-comment (`ihe-iti-vhl-1-0-0-comment`, CC BY 4.0). Every knowledge-graph reference to these upstream IHE specifications resolves through here, and `check:materialized-fixity` verifies their SHA-256 digests against `catalogue/`. Bean sl5v.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Materialized specification snapshots of upstream IHE ITI Technical Framework supplements (CC BY 4.0); `check:materialized-fixity` verifies their SHA-256 digests against `catalogue/`.

directories.description: Qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) and materialization fixity (`folio-catalogue-node/v1`) records for the upstream IHE ITI specifications materialized in `library/`: IHE ITI PCF 1.1.0 and IHE ITI VHL 1.0.0-comment. `bun run cat check:catalogue` and `bun run cat check:materialized-fixity` verify every node, metadataRef, libraryId, localPath, and SHA-256 digest. Bean sl5v.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Records of content materialized from IHE ITI Technical Framework supplements (`profiles.ihe.net`); `check:materialized-fixity` verifies the SHA-256 digests recorded here against `library/`.

the IG's menu: built by fhir-harness's ig-index:build from the IG's AST (restored from the IG repository's AST cache) and its own sushi-config.yaml, so it moves when the IG's default branch or its AST cache moves, not with a commit of this instance (fhir-harness#124)

the IG's release list: built by fhir-harness's ig-index:build from the IG's AST (restored from the IG repository's AST cache) and its own sushi-config.yaml, so it moves when the IG's default branch or its AST cache moves, not with a commit of this instance (fhir-harness#124)

the Publisher-shaped package the JSON view pages read each resource from: built by fhir-harness's ig-index:build from the IG's AST (restored from the IG repository's AST cache) and its own sushi-config.yaml, so it moves when the IG's default branch or its AST cache moves, not with a commit of this instance (fhir-harness#124)
the DAK view of this IG's artefact index, which is itself built at publish (fhir-artifact-index/index.json above), so the report moves with the index and is built after it (fhir-harness#124)
